acceptance.independent_store_concurrency: PASS - two simultaneous APPLY_MOCK claims from separate Store engines sharing one SQLite database contend at an application-automation ceiling of one; exactly one becomes RUNNING and the other remains QUEUED with zero attempts.
acceptance.category_isolation: PASS - a PREPARE operation can still claim while one APPLY_MOCK operation is RUNNING, demonstrating that the document-generation ceiling is independent.
acceptance.durable_readback: PASS - operation state and attempt counts read back through the second Store instance.
acceptance.requirement_scope: PARTIAL - this adds acceptance coverage for the existing database-backed application-automation category claim. Real ATS concurrency and live PostgreSQL advisory-lock behavior remain unverified; other requirement coverage is tracked separately.

environment.database: Temporary synthetic SQLite shared by two independent Store engines; no migrations changed.
environment.browser: NOT_RUN - no browser/UI code changed; the asserted behavior is operation admission before a browser worker can start.
environment.postgresql: NOT_RUN - live PostgreSQL runtime was unavailable; the optional PostgreSQL concurrency test was not run in this focused slice.
environment.docker: NOT_RUN - no container or migration behavior changed.
environment.hosted_checks_and_review: NOT_RUN_BY_USER_POLICY; GitHub Actions and hosted reviewers remain disabled.

limitations: This slice adds missing race acceptance coverage; the category-lock implementation itself was already present on main.
Separate Store engines in one process exercise SQLite database serialization but do not prove separate OS-process contention or PostgreSQL advisory-lock behavior.
Real ATS browser-worker concurrency remains unverified and external submission remains OFF.
